answer_1.quote: We propose the task of text fact transfer, which aims to modify the factual content of a source text while preserving its style.

answer_2.quote: We measure the output similarity of the predicted and target texts with ROUGE-1/2 (R1/R2) and BLEU... To evaluate factuality, we adopt three metrics: Halluc, FactCC, NLI-Ent.

answer_4.quote: We invite two computer science and engineering students to evaluate 50 generated outputs ... Following best practices, we use a pairwise comparative evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: pairwise comparative evaluation of generated outputs
